expected_behavior: RTL for module sync_fifo (DEPTH 8, WIDTH 8 by default; any DEPTH of 2 or more) with ports clk rst_n wr_en wr_data full rd_en rd_data empty count, first-word fall-through, and a self-checking testbench, gated by lint, simulation, and synthesis (and formal, when a .sby is written) before review.
constraints: Work only from the approved interface specification and microarchitecture.
Correct for a DEPTH that is not a power of two.
Lint-clean under Verilator -Wall with no waivers.
known_failure_modes: Pointer wrap written for power-of-two depths only.
A write while full or a read while empty not dropped.
Full with a simultaneous write and read accepting the write.
count wrong at the full boundary.
A self-written testbench that never reaches full or empty; the held-out reference testbench (with coverage counters) judges instead.
A self-written testbench that cannot tell an overflowing or power-of-two-only FIFO from a correct one; the must-fail control fails it.
